audit.corrected: Rewrote dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d to match their titles, fixed both misgender instances to 'her', and added real numbers to breakdown.cooldowns (W is 0s/always up, E is 10s, R is 120/110/100s and can't target a devoured ally).
